# Thunderbird supplies a true default for the Inspector comment-node preference

This scoped port adds devtools.markup.showComments with a true default to Thunderbird's preference file. The fixed accepted source retains the same declaration. These comm sources establish the supplied default; the engine's comment-node filtering and toggle behavior remain unverified.

Scope: Thunderbird DevTools default preferences.
